name: sealeap-amazon-seller-tax-compliance-triage
description: Prepare an evidence-based tax-compliance triage pack for Amazon cross-border sellers by mapping entities, marketplaces, goods flow, customs declarations, invoices, settlements, returns, and inventory reconciliation, then framing questions for qualified tax and customs advisers. Use when users ask about 0110, 1039, 9810, offshore entities, historical gaps, or future compliance. This is not tax or legal advice and must not enable evasion.
